competitions.name: Code Sprint
competitions.description: A problem-solving coding event focused on logic, debugging, and fast implementation.
rules: Teams must have 2 to 4 members from a recognized college.
Every team should bring at least one laptop with the required coding tools.
Internet use is allowed only if the round coordinator announces it.
The final submission must be uploaded before the timer ends.

competitions.name: Business Plan Pitch
competitions.description: Teams pitch a startup idea, market strategy, and revenue plan to a panel.
rules: Teams must submit a clear business theme and problem statement.
Presentation time is limited and will be stopped once the bell rings.
Only original ideas are accepted; copied plans will be rejected.
Judging will consider feasibility, creativity, and delivery.

competitions.name: Robotics Rush
competitions.description: Build and control a robot to complete a timed task in the arena.
rules: All machines must satisfy the size and power rules announced at check-in.
Teams are responsible for their own device safety and spare parts.
Unsafe operation can lead to immediate disqualification.
Judging will combine task completion, accuracy, and timing.

competitions.name: Poster Design
competitions.description: Create a visual poster around a campus or social innovation theme.
rules: Teams must finish their poster within the announced design window.
All submitted work must be original and prepared by the team.
Judging considers concept clarity, layout, and visual impact.
Final files should be submitted in the format requested by coordinators.
